narrative_vs_numbers.summary: ICICI Bank demonstrated strong operational execution across Q3 FY26 to Q2 FY27, maintaining net interest margins near 4.18% to 4.36% and expanding overall loan growth to 30.0% year-on-year in Q2 FY27. Management successfully executed strategic initiatives, such as mobilizing $18 billion in gross FCNR (B) deposits, while keeping credit costs contained despite a one-time ₹1,283 crore PSL standard asset provision in Q3 FY26.
